title: E2EE VTC call metadata leaks via Scene spatial presence events
description: When a VTCCall with e2eeEnabled: true is bound to a SceneRegion via activeCallId, Scene WSS delivers SceneAvatarEvent (enter/leave with displayName) to all region subscribers. This reveals real-time call participant presence via the Scene channel, undermining the E2EE privacy contract. VTC security section 'Call Metadata Exposure' (vtc-00.md lines 1552-1554) flags metadata concerns for VTC only. Scene's 'Spatial Metadata Exposure' (scene-00.md lines 2263-2265) does not mention E2EE calls. Need: guidance or suppression mechanism for Scene presence events when bound to E2EE calls.
